$comment: Popup configs in DEV (api-dev.deepdots.com, company MAGICFEEDBACK_DEV) used by the native test apps (MF-3244). One popup config per scenario, so each run gets exactly the popups it tests. The public keys are public by design: they are what a customer's app ships with. Both apps read this file at build time. If you change a popup here, change it in the DEV Admin Panel too.

checkout-time.title: Did anything stop you from completing your order?

exit-checkout.describe: exit trigger (2 s) when leaving /checkout, shown on the destination screen
exit-checkout.title: Why did you leave the checkout?

rate-product.describe: event rate_product (bottom sheet "Submit rating"), complex survey
rate-product.title: Tell us what you think of this product

redisplay.describe: time_on_page 2 s on /account with cooldown SHOWED 1 day: shown once, not again after a restart
redisplay.title: How is your account?

audience-lang.describe: audience segmentation: two popups on rate_product, segments.lang en / es; the app language picks one
audience-lang.title: Rate this product (EN audience)

release-fixtures.describe: release/fixtures/popups/*.json (MF-3242) served by the DEV API, with the real simple survey; path and es-only segments dropped, legacy trigger stored in the current shape
release-fixtures.title: Quick question

fault-survey-missing.describe: fault: popup on event fault_survey whose survey id does not exist, so the survey fails to load
fault-survey-missing.title: This survey does not exist

client-replica.describe: DEV replica of a client app popup (MF-3263): time_on_page 5 s, cooldown SHOWED/PARTIAL/COMPLETED 7 days, segments lang en + path /, centered. Survey 307a1410-d374-11f1-90cc-b367d26c08ff (da): rating 1-5 'Meget dårlig'/'Meget god', long text, yes/no, email; linear, without the branching of the original
client-replica.title: Hvordan vil du vurdere din oplevelse med appen?

client-replica-da.describe: same as client-replica but segments.lang da (path /): with SDK >= 0.7.4 it shows with lang=da and not with lang=en
client-replica-da.title: Hvordan vil du vurdere din oplevelse med appen?

client-exact.describe: Exact DEV copy of a client app popup as in prod on 3-nov-2026 (event jhgjgjhg, cooldown SHOWED 14 / PARTIAL 30 / COMPLETED 30 days, segments path / and no lang, centered). Survey 9c449790-d781-11f1-ab45-8bbb0ec1d341 (da), same questions, branching and colours as the client's: rating 1-5, a follow-up text per rating band (1-2 / 3-4 / 5), yes/no, text, yes/no, email. The client logo is not uploaded in DEV
client-exact.title: Hvordan vil du vurdere din oplevelse med appen?

client-exact-launch.describe: Same as client-exact but on time_on_page 5 s, the client's setup before 30-oct: the popup opens by itself at app start (the case of the double popup on 0.7.5)
client-exact-launch.title: Hvordan vil du vurdere din oplevelse med appen?

fault-popups-error.describe: fault: unknown public key, GET /sdk/{key}/popups answers 406 and no popup loads

e2e-scroll.describe: scroll trigger 50 % on /shop, simple survey. The Lab buttons scroll:30 / scroll:60 are the host reporting onScroll()
e2e-scroll.title: E2E · Scroll 50%

e2e-multi-trigger.describe: two triggers on one popup: event e2e_multi or click help-button
e2e-multi-trigger.title: E2E · Event or click

e2e-inactive.describe: popup on event e2e_inactive set to DEPRECATED (inactive): the API returns no popup, nothing shows
e2e-inactive.title: E2E · Inactive popup

e2e-cooldown-partial.describe: event e2e_partial, cooldown PARTIAL 1 day, complex survey: after a partial answer it does not show again
e2e-cooldown-partial.title: E2E · Cooldown after a partial answer

e2e-cooldown-completed.describe: event e2e_completed, cooldown COMPLETED 1 day, simple survey: after completing it does not show again
e2e-cooldown-completed.title: E2E · Cooldown after completing

e2e-two-popups.describe: two popups (A and B) on the same event e2e_two: one at a time
e2e-two-popups.title: E2E · Popup A

e2e-dark-font.describe: event e2e_style, dark theme, font family Georgia
e2e-dark-font.title: E2E · Dark theme and custom font
